name: brain_record
description: Start or stop recording laps the user drives by hand, for the brain to learn from. With the truck running, start records laps until `laps` more have completed (a crashed lap restarts at the start); with then_autopilot it then trains and lets the Autopilot drive the slalom, so "drive it yourself twice and I'll learn it" is one call: start true, laps 2, then_autopilot true. Stop aborts the lap being driven. With no truck running it drives the brain panel's preview. The drone works the same way on a drone course (hoop course, hover, landing): fly the laps by hand through the targets in order, and with then_autopilot Albie trains and flies it.

laps.description: Completed laps to record before stopping (default 2).

then_autopilot.description: Train and run the Autopilot when the laps are done (default false).

name: brain_train
description: Train the brain on the completed laps (at least 2), a few ms a frame, with its live loss curve. With no truck running it starts the brain panel's training preview. For the drone, each training is a new version (drone_autopilot v1, v2, ...) that is first rehearsed on the recorded course line; a version that fails rehearsal is reported as not ready rather than flown.

name: autopilot_on
description: Let the trained brain drive the truck through the slalom: each trained candidate, then the pretrained fallback, gets a run until one completes. With no truck running it shows the brain panel's Autopilot preview. On a drone course it flies the drone with the selected trained version (best rehearsed candidate first); any stick input, autopilot_off, a crash or the time limit ends it. If the trained version isn't ready it refuses and says why.

version.description: Optional: the trained version to use (1-based, see brain_status versions). Default: the newest.

follow_line.description: Drone only, only when the user asks for it: fly the non-learned course-line follower (straight from target to target). It is not the trained model; say so.

name: autopilot_off
description: Stop the Autopilot and give the truck back to the manual controller. With no truck running it returns the brain panel's preview to its ready state. The drone hovers where it is, back on the sticks.

name: brain_status
description: Read the brain's state: mode (idle, lap, training, autopilot), completed laps, laps to go, training progress, who drove the last Autopilot run, and preview_only (true when no truck is running and only the panel preview answers). Also: thing (truck or drone), course, versions and selected_version; for the drone, ready (whether the selected version passed rehearsal).
